_comment: Bundled playbooks: the prose half of the audit, shipped inside the plugin so
it runs the same on any machine. They were adapted from separate skills, and
copying them in was a deliberate trade — a playbook does not get upstream bug
fixes the way a script does, and a missing skill degrades an audit silently,
which is worse than a copy going slightly stale. Provenance is in CREDITS.md.
A playbook tells a person or an agent how to answer an item. It never answers
one by itself: nothing here may move a status without the work actually being
done. A test asserts every id below exists in the registry.

local-seo.use_when: profile is `local`, or LO-196 came back PASS, or LO-199 is MANUAL
local-seo.leaves_status: LO-199 stays MANUAL — it cannot read the live Business Profile

competitor-research.use_when: answering CO-191 in the LLM queue, or planning link targets
competitor-research.leaves_status: CO-191 is N/A unless a search actually ran — firecrawl, exa or WebSearch

client-report-structure.use_when: the audit is going to a client or a decision meeting
client-report-structure.leaves_status: presentation only — no status, score or coverage number changes
